tasks.title: Backend API and WebSocket alignment
tasks.description: REST routes, voice/chamber WebSockets, health, and monetization hooks match documented architecture.
tasks.details: Implemented in orchestrator (api.py, monetization, workforce, config). Human: confirm production IIS or reverse proxy maps the same paths.

tasks.title: Frontend build and API wiring
tasks.description: Vite dev proxy and getApiBase/getWsBase so UI hits the real backend in dev and build.
tasks.details: Human: set production env vars for hosting (Vercel/static + API origin) per docs/DRIFT_PREVENTION.md.
tasks.testStrategy: npm ci --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend

tasks.title: CI pipeline (backend + frontend)
tasks.description: GitHub Actions runs pytest subset and frontend build without missing tools.
tasks.details: Workflow in .github/workflows/main.yml. Human: enable branch protection on main requiring this workflow.
tasks.testStrategy: Push to dev and confirm Actions green.

tasks.title: Repository hygiene and secrets policy
tasks.description: Ignore mcp.json, lineage noise, local DB; example MCP config only.
tasks.details: Human: rotate any key that was ever in a tracked file or shared log; store secrets in host env or vault only.
tasks.testStrategy: git check-ignore .cursor/mcp.json; ensure no sk_live in tracked source.

tasks.title: Taskmaster file backlog for launch
tasks.description: Local tasks.json and PRD for launch/monetization; file storage enabled.
tasks.details: Optional: run task-master parse-prd on .taskmaster/docs/PRD-launch-monetization-v1.md when AI keys are configured in .env.

tasks.title: Staging end-to-end (test Stripe)
tasks.description: Validate webhooks and a happy-path user journey in staging with test keys.
tasks.details: Human: provision staging DB/Redis; set STRIPE_TEST_MODE and test keys; run stripe listen against staging URL.
tasks.testStrategy: Stripe CLI test events + manual UI smoke on staging hostname.

tasks.title: Legal and policy pages
tasks.description: Terms, privacy, cookie/refund policy, affiliate disclosures as required by jurisdiction and offers.
tasks.details: Human-only: attorney or qualified template review before linking from checkout and outreach.
tasks.testStrategy: Legal sign-off checklist attached to release ticket.

tasks.title: Production DNS and TLS
tasks.description: api and app hostnames with valid certificates.
tasks.details: Human: DNS A/AAAA or CNAME to hosting; confirm HSTS and cookie domain policy with frontend env.
tasks.testStrategy: curl -I https://api.../health and browser padlock on marketing site.

tasks.title: Stripe live mode cutover
tasks.description: Live products/prices, webhook secret, tax settings if applicable.
tasks.details: Human: Stripe dashboard configuration; paste secrets only into production env, never git.
tasks.testStrategy: Small real charge + refund in controlled window; webhook delivery 200 in Stripe dashboard.

tasks.title: Outreach production enablement
tasks.description: Cold outreach per docs/marketing/COLD_OUTREACH_SOP_v2.md with human-approved lists and copy.
tasks.details: Human: confirm CAN-SPAM/GDPR constraints; raise sending limits gradually; keep OUTREACH_DRY_RUN until satisfied.
tasks.testStrategy: Dry-run log review then capped live send with reply monitoring.

tasks.title: Observability and backups
tasks.description: Centralized logs, uptime checks, DB backups for production.
tasks.details: Human: choose provider (cloud logging, PagerDuty, etc.) and document runbooks.
tasks.testStrategy: Simulated failure triggers alert; restore test from backup snapshot.

tasks.title: Release tagging and changelog
tasks.description: Semantic version tag aligned with package.json and pyproject.toml.
tasks.details: Human: git tag -a v1.0.1 -m ... after merges; publish GitHub Release notes.
tasks.testStrategy: Tag points to commit with green CI on main.

tasks.title: Remove legacy webhooks.py router artifact
tasks.description: Delete orchestrator/src/core/monetization/webhooks.py — it is never mounted and duplicates api.py unified_stripe_webhook (line 515). Confirmed 2026-04-12.
tasks.details: Safe to delete: no include_router call exists in api.py. Canonical handler is unified_stripe_webhook at POST /api/v1/monetization/webhook in api.py. After deletion, run: poetry run pytest tests/integration/test_api_endpoints.py -q to confirm no import references break.
tasks.testStrategy: poetry run pytest tests/integration/test_api_endpoints.py -q after deletion.
